project.name: Databases Knowledge
project.description: A personal, expert level knowledge base about databases: technology agnostic concepts organized by the Data management systems branch of the ACM Computing Classification System, a dedicated area for concrete engines such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB and Redis, and case studies.
